## Disposition and exact scope

Accept the credited prior resolution of 30000779 / OWR-1586-003 within the original convention that p is odd OR k is totally imaginary. For every such number field/prime, arbitrary finite tame S and prescribed Dirichlet-density-one D, there is finite A contained in D minus (S union S_p) such that Spec(O_k) minus (S union A) is K(pi,1) for p. Remove class-number and cyclotomic restrictions. S may be empty and need not lie in D; no uniform size or norm bound is claimed.

Credit Alexander Schmidt and John Labute–Ján Mináč. Zero new substantive proof-search turns; no novelty claim. The literal catalogue omitted the original real-place convention: retain SOURCE_SCOPE. This candidate neither resolves nor classifies as open an unrestricted real-field p=2 formulation. No QUEUE change.

## Essential corrections and acceptance boundary

Read all four complete, byte-preserved authored documents: first_audit/PRIOR_RESOLUTION_AUDIT.md, first_audit/NESTED_DEPENDENCY_LEDGER.md, second_audit/INDEPENDENT_ACCEPTANCE_REPORT.md, and second_audit/LOCAL_CONDITION_CLARIFICATION.md.

Acceptance includes all essential repairs:

- The p-adic Kummer denominator is the local-unit image C_v=O_v^* k_v^{*p}/k_v^{*p}, not ordinary Galois-unramified H^1(mu_p). Its dual annihilator is the unramified F_p-character subgroup.
- The first local products of (I) and (II) are indexed by T, while the expressly identified S factors remain S.
- psi_a is nonzero on Frob(q_a), not p_a. The old H^1 dimension is at least two; the number-field residue-degree descent is explicit.
- Restore I_a consistently in the cyclic field F_a, its Frobenius kernel and chi_a's H^1 space. Require n>=3 and p^n-2-n>0; choose psi_a in old U.
- At p=2 verify both off-diagonal cup directions via Lemma 5.2 and diagonal square vanishing via splitting in k(i). Anticommutativity alone is insufficient.

The preserved audits state the exact imported-foundation boundary. Standard arithmetic duality, class field theory, PBW, etale homotopy and the other listed imports are not independently reproved from foundations. These are authored audit corrections, not an author-issued or publisher-issued erratum. No source theorem is computationally certified.

The eight preserved inputs include public historical source metadata and manifests. First-audit pending-review language is historical; the second audit records completion. Author-manuscript/arXiv inspection and comparison are distinguished from publisher-PDF identity, which is not asserted. The first metadata field pdf_signature_valid means PDF-header detection only, explicitly corrected by the second review; no cryptographic signature verification is claimed. Source hash agreement is not authentication of historical network provenance. No new publication-stage source replay or source download is claimed.

## Public reproduction and trust chain

Authenticate BOOTSTRAP.py against the independent SHA-256 below before executing it, and copy that authenticated file outside the packet. Set packet files to 0444 and directories to 0555, then use actual UID=EUID=1000:

- python -I -S -B /trusted/BOOTSTRAP.py --controls /path/to/packet
- python -I -S -B -O /trusted/BOOTSTRAP.py --controls /path/to/packet
- python -I -S -B -OO /trusted/BOOTSTRAP.py --controls /path/to/packet

The fixed external bootstrap binds the manifest, verifier and rejection harness. The manifest binds every other delivered byte, including every included receipt and raw stdout/stderr reference. The manifest excludes only itself and BOOTSTRAP.py, whose hashes are bound outward; final replay receipts stay outside the bound inventory to avoid circular hashes. The external hash must be trusted from this reviewed channel, not selected afresh from an untrusted download.

Each mode verifies eight unchanged input documents and two exact scope declarations. These are document controls, not mathematical proof-check counts. Separately, 42 integrity rejections, 62 schema/scope rejections, 32 complete-output comparator rejections and 29 physical create/append-open/unlink denials pass per mode. Intended rejection reasons are fixed and checked. Empty, malformed, changed, skipped, expected-failure, identity/count-altered and wrong-mode outputs fail closed. Full raw stdout/stderr equality and recursive exact JSON types are checked; hostile environment/current-directory imports match the complete baseline and packet hashes remain unchanged. The runtime and standard library are trusted; permission modes do not protect against root or deliberate owner chmod.

Source-body, historical retrieval/inspection, excluded-material, new source search, dataset, full foundational proof, formal proof assistant, computational mathematical certification, publisher-PDF comparison and cryptographic PDF-signature verification are NOT_RUN. Only authored audits/clarification, acceptance, safe verification code, public source metadata and verification receipts are included. No source PDFs/text/images, datasets, private sources, private personal or coordination material, or identifying metadata for excluded private material.
